_comment: Spatial words drawn as a picture, not searched for and not clozed (tunatale-hvj0, the user 2026-09-28: 'they become picture cards'). Each maps a word to a language-neutral concept in app.cards.spatial_scenes.SPATIAL_CONCEPTS. A word listed here is NOT a function word, whatever `function_words.json` or a POS tag says: app.srs.function_words.is_function_word vetoes it, so it cards as vocab and its image is drawn. The picture is only drawn when the card's English gloss names the relation (app.cards.spatial_picture.gloss_matches), which is what keeps a homograph's other sense off the picture. Map only words whose MAIN sense is spatial: na/v/za/med/pred stay clozes — each has a common non-spatial sense (za = for, med = during or honey, pred = ago, na/v also mark time and direction), and the cloze drills the case they govern. Distinct words get distinct pictures (2026-09-29, tunatale-fsyd): Slovene makes Norwegian's going/being split — gor/dol are going up/down, zgoraj/spodaj are BEING up/down — so zgoraj and spodaj take the up_there and down_there drawings instead of sharing nad's above and pod's under. poleg and zraven, true synonyms for 'beside', share on the user's call.
